slots.jd.produce-hauler.about: Stillwater Produce Haulers is a family-owned business that moves fresh produce by truck. We are looking for a Senior Truck Driver to join our team. This is an on-site job in Fresno, CA. You will work out of our yard alongside our drivers and dispatch staff, and you will help keep our loads moving safely and on schedule.
slots.jd.produce-hauler.duties:
What the job involves
- Train new drivers on safe driving, inspections and our daily routines
- Deliver produce to customers on time and in good condition
- Coordinate with dispatch on pickups, drop-offs and schedule changes
- Check loads and paperwork before each run
- Report vehicle problems so trucks are repaired before they go back on the road
slots.jd.produce-hauler.needs:
What you need
- 9 or more years of experience as a truck driver
- Hands-on skill in pre-trip inspections and vehicle maintenance checks
- Solid habits in defensive driving and route planning
- Accurate cargo documentation and fuel and mileage logs
- A current Hazardous Materials Endorsement (required)
- A Dispatch Coordinator Certificate (preferred)
slots.r1.b1: Trains new drivers on pre-trip inspections and safe vehicle handling, cutting inspection-related delays by 50 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Carries out pre-trip vehicle inspections and checks bills of lading against each load before leaving the yard.
slots.r1.b3: Secures and checks every load, applying careful trailer coupling to reduce load shift incidents by 40 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Coordinates with dispatch on pickups and drop-offs, keeping cargo documentation complete and current for each run.
slots.r1.i1: Builds driver schedules and routes for the Granite Ridge Transport team while driving as a Senior Truck Driver.
slots.r1.i2: Drives as a Senior Truck Driver at Granite Ridge Transport and reports vehicle defects promptly so trucks are repaired before they return to the road.
slots.r2.b1: Kept accurate driver logs and practised defensive driving on every route, lowering incident reports by 20 percent.
slots.r2.b2: Reported vehicle defects to maintenance as soon as they were found, using hours-of-service logging to record downtime accurately.
slots.r2.b3: Planned routes ahead of each run and confirmed customer signoff at delivery, reducing disputed deliveries by 35 percent.
slots.r2.b4: Performed pre-trip vehicle inspections and kept fuel and mileage logs up to date for each truck.
slots.r2.i1: Planned routes for Class A loads at Tidewater Haulers, balancing delivery windows with safe driving time.
slots.r2.i2: Drove Class A trucks for Tidewater Haulers and kept complete, accurate driver logs for every trip.
slots.r3.b1: Secured and checked loads before departure, using pre-trip inspections to cut damaged deliveries by 50 percent.
slots.r3.b2: Coordinated with dispatch on delivery changes and kept bills of lading matched to each shipment.
slots.r3.b3: Delivered to customers on time, using quick and correct trailer coupling to shorten yard departures by 20 percent.
slots.r3.b4: Maintained driver logs alongside cargo documentation for every stop on the delivery route.
slots.r3.i1: Kept daily driver logs as a Delivery Driver for Stonebridge Logistics, recording each stop and shift accurately.
slots.r3.i2: Delivered goods to Stonebridge Logistics customers on time, working to agreed delivery windows on each assigned route.
slots.summary.1: Senior truck driver with about 9 years of experience in commercial driving and dispatch support, guiding newer drivers and taking on the hardest loads and routes. Skilled in trailer coupling, fuel and mileage logs and hours-of-service logging, and holds a Commercial Driver Licence and Hazardous Materials Endorsement.
slots.summary.2: Truck driving and dispatch professional with about 9 years on the road, the person colleagues turn to for advice and for the most difficult deliveries. Keeps trailer coupling safe, fuel and mileage logs accurate and hours-of-service logging complete on every run.
